findings.headline: Seeded admin cannot open the internal visibility drawer
findings.rootCause: The internal visibility surface is superuser-only, but the seeded admin user is not a Django superuser. The frontend only renders the Internal-mode link when isSuperuser is true, and the backend route/API also require user.is_superuser, so the scenario-authenticated user cannot access the route the test depends on.
findings.whatHappened: The run logged in as the seeded admin and opened the sidebar user menu, but the menu did not show the Internal-mode button, so the agent stayed on Home. Prior history has no successful runs.

findings.headline: Evaluations test-company toggle unreachable for the seeded admin
findings.rootCause: The written test requires clicking Internal, but that control is gated behind isSuperuser in SidebarUserMenu.tsx. The scenario recipe seeds the admin with isStaff: true only, and the user DTO defaults is_superuser to false, so the required menu item cannot render. The failure is in the scenario's auth-role setup, not the PR.
findings.whatHappened: The run opened the sidebar user menu, but it had no Internal option, so the agent never reached Evaluations. The final screen stayed on Home with no app errors.

findings.headline: Internal visibility health view never opens
findings.rootCause: The test expects to enter Internal mode and open the visibility view, but that surface is superuser-only. The seeded admin user is only isStaff: true in scenario-recipes.json, while the sidebar renders the Internal link only for isSuperuser in SidebarUserMenu.tsx and the backend guard also requires request.user.is_superuser in internal_views.py.
findings.whatHappened: The run opened the sidebar user menu but saw no Internal option, so it never reached the visibility view. No app error was visible; the test has never passed before.

findings.headline: Test assumes a deterministic single-prompt discovery path
findings.rootCause: The written plan assumes one prompt will deterministically produce the exact continue actions and unlock the conversation-stage simulation, but the implemented discovery flow can ask additional questions before advancing. The simulation button is gated on the discovery stage completing.

findings.headline: Test expects one prompt to complete every discovery stage
findings.rootCause: The written plan assumes one chat prompt immediately completes Context, Strategy, Conversation, and Launch, then exposes Quality Check. The implemented flow in discovery/SKILL.md is conversational and requires follow-up questions before advancing.

findings.headline: Test assumes a short sentence completes the Context stage
findings.rootCause: The written test assumes one short sentence is enough to complete Context and expose the continue control. The implemented flow in discovery/SKILL.md first opens an empty canvas, sends the fixed opener, and waits for discovery material before advancing.

findings.headline: Fixed continue-clicks never reach Quality Check
findings.rootCause: The written plan assumes the advisor advances through Context, Strategy, and Conversation by repeatedly clicking a stable continue option. In the implemented skill, discovery/SKILL.md drives dynamic ask_user_question prompts, so the fixed-click path never reaches Quality Check.

findings.headline: Fixed continue-clicks leave the Quality Check footer unrendered
findings.rootCause: The written test assumes three fixed continue clicks always advance through Context, Strategy, Conversation, and Launch. In the observed run the app was still asking a Strategy follow-up question, so the Launch stage stayed locked and the Quality Check footer could not render.

findings.headline: Deleted threads intentionally remain in the default recents list
findings.rootCause: The test asserts a deleted thread should be absent from the default sidebar list after refresh, but the implemented sidebar defaults the recents status filter to 'all'. Deletion is a soft delete, so the thread still appears under the 'all' filter by design.

findings.headline: Create-plan button hidden by a feature flag
findings.rootCause: The plans page only renders the creation CTA when the SHOW_CREATE_PLAN_BUTTON feature flag is enabled. In this run the flag evaluated false or unresolved, so the table received canCreate=false and omitted the primary action.

findings.headline: Test expects the old fixed Quality Check score
findings.rootCause: The written test is stale for this PR: it expects the old fixed Quality Check score of 3.5 even though the PR intentionally moves scoring to backend evaluation data. The modal now maps evaluation.overall into a dynamic eval score.
